import{useState,useEffect}from'react';import{StrategyType}from'../../../types';import{PnLCalculator}from'../../../services/calculators/pnlCalculator';import{useAutoSave}from'../../../hooks/useAutoSave';export const usePnLPageState=()=>{// Core params state
